name: readiness-probe-failure
question: Pod web-api running 但一直 0/1 not ready,流量进不来

cluster.pod.get.observation: Pod web-api 状态 Running 但 readiness 0/1;readinessProbe httpGet /healthz:8080

cluster.event.list.observation: Warning Unhealthy Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503

cluster.pod.log.tail.observation: 日志: /healthz returned 503, dependency database not connected

conclusion:
### 结论
Pod web-api 的 readiness 探针因 /healthz 返回 503(后端 database 未连接)持续失败,Pod 不就绪故不接收流量 [E1][E2][E3]。
### 证据
- [E1] pod.get: Running 但 readiness 0/1
- [E2] event.list: Readiness probe failed 503
- [E3] log.tail: /healthz 503 dependency database not connected
### 建议
- 排查 database 连接配置与可达性,恢复后探针自动转就绪
### 准确性提示
根因指向下游依赖,建议确认 database 服务状态。
